{{Quote|Probably. We've got the fighters who survived the Tocan system disaster recuperating in Ghorman; they'll be maybe 75% effective in two weeks. Plus, we can strip Tierfon, Homon and Farstey for the other wing, ''if'' the Imps hold off on their offensive in that region.|Chief of Sector Command|<ref name="RAS">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>}}
'''Tierfon''' was a small [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Tierfon system/Legends|Tierfon system]] of the [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]], located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. Its surface was dotted with mountain ranges, huge gorges, and rock cliffs.

After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Alaric (Sephi)|Alaric]] the whole sector including this planet, left the Republic and joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Tierfon was the site of the [[Tierfon Rebel Outpost|Tierfon Rebel Base]], and home of the [[Tierfon Yellow Aces/Legends|Tierfon Yellow Aces]].
